title: App Builder Artifact Revision
description: One candidate product revision, and the single lifecycle it travels. Before this contract the factory used `generated`, `verified`, `launchable`, convergence and visual promotion to describe different narrow facts, which made it possible to read `build succeeded` as `ready to release`. Each state here names exactly one earned guarantee and nothing beyond it. Identity is append-only: a component may be recorded once, and changed bytes cannot inherit the evidence of the bytes they replaced — rework forks a child revision that re-earns every state below it.

parentRevisionId.description: The revision this one reworks. Null for the first revision of an approved contract.

producedBy.description: Who or what materialised this revision. Recorded so the reducer can refuse a producer that accepts its own work (principle 17).

lifecycleState.description: The first eight are the success ladder, in order, each earned only from the one before it. The last three are terminal dispositions and are never success states.

identity.description: What this revision exactly is. Every component starts null, is written once by the transition that earns it, and refuses a second, different value.

contractDigest.description: The approved Product Contract this revision is built against.

sourceDigest.description: The generated source tree. Changing it is a different revision, not an edit to this one.

lockDigest.description: The dependency lockfile the build resolved against. An exact source tree over floating transitive dependencies is not an exact artifact.

toolchain.description: The exact declared Node and npm pair the build ran under.

outputDigest.description: The built output manifest. This is what behaviour, quality and release evidence is about; the source alone is not.

deployId.description: The provider's own identifier for the exact published deploy. Set when the revision is released and never rewritten.

history.description: Every transition this revision has made, in order. The reducer appends; nothing rewrites.

from.description: Null only for the transition that created the revision.

basis.description: Why this state was earned, in one sentence a person can check against the evidence.

evidenceRefs.description: Identifiers of the artifacts that earned the state. The lifecycle records which evidence was claimed; binding it to this revision's digests belongs to the evidence reducer.
